x: McMullen, Hyde, Pope, Scammel, Green, Fletcher and Holland, were the most prominent. The race proceeded with the first position undecided and not until two miles from home could Green, Pope and Hyde shake off the others.

McMullen were some distance behind, walking together with Holland, Batson and Sandy. Derby and Birmingham were still scoring much better than either Belgrave or Surrey A.C, who made up the third and fourth placings.
At the end of the first lap Green was leading with Holland. Then came Rathbone, and Bidgood, Harley and Fletcher walked together, filling 8th, 9th and 10th positions.

There were 149 starters and the Sheffield lads were soon to the front with Hardy, Holland and Allen filling the first three places. At 4 miles Syd James was 15th, Eric Hall 18th, George Checkley 30th, Hugh McGreechan 36th and Bob Newson 40th.
McMullen, Hyde, Pope, Scammell, Green, Fletcher and Holland were the most prominent. Our 'A' team packed in fine fashion to win the scratch team race (3,6,7,9).
As the race got under way 19 year-old Yitbarek Dinku tagged on to a small leading bunch that included Boxhill's Haywood and Crawley's Holland.
